Everyone looks at each other and the props in front of them, never into the lens. At 1 s, DECLAN kicks the truck's tire; dust bursts off it. At 4 s, SAMIRA NADEER speaks [flat: "Your company is gone. The truck is all you have."]. At 8 s, DECLAN slaps the hood and climbs in. Motion carries on through the last half second. [Adults only, no kids. Invented characters; a named real person becomes only their moves and attitude, never their likeness. No gore; bloodstains on clothing are fine, no blood draining out. Nobody looks into the camera.]
